CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2633 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 3dc9ae19b33be293d7eb9fb07116b014427a2aa5. Bus nonce: f6f116a23187ea37d896733dff8dfd9d. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 3dc9ae19b33be293d7eb9fb07116b014427a2aa5`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 3dc9ae19b33be293d7eb9fb07116b014427a2aa5` or `Fix review: blocked 3dc9ae19b33be293d7eb9fb07116b014427a2aa5 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: f6f116a23187ea37d896733dff8dfd9d`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2633 3dc9ae19b33be293d7eb9fb07116b014427a2aa5") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2633-f6f116a2`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer, round 3, PR #2633 (tvofi/heatpump_optimizer), R10-FLOW-ARCH-PLANNER. Head 3dc9ae19b33be293d7eb9fb07116b014427a2aa5. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md from a detached worktree at that head. Re-read the head first; if it moved, the verdict is blocked.

Round 2 (git fetch origin probe/rev-2633-*; read the latest verdict.md) blocked because CLAUDE.md read 3627 tokens against its 3609 cap after main's #2631 merged. Round 3 claims to pay this inside CLAUDE.md with no budget raise. Verify:
1. CLAUDE.md reads 3605 against a cap of 3605 (or the cap the budget file holds at the head), and the policy corpus total matches the body. No *_budgets.json key was raised (diff three-dot against origin/main).
2. Two of the cuts remove text that main's CLAUDE.md already had. Name each cut. Judge it as a policy edit: does it change what any seat must do, or is it a true duplicate whose rule still stands in the file it cites? A cut that drops an obligation is a blocked verdict.
3. The new roster_edit DEFER refusal check in the self-test (117 checks): it fails on its own mutant (let DEFER through) and passes on the fix. Run your own mutant too.
4. policy_lint reports TOTAL 0 at the head and on a simulated merge with current origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`).
5. The body's figures hold at this head. tests/entities.py: the fixer saw 4 py-spy heartbeat failures on a Mac that also fail at the base; say whether CI at the head shows them.
6. Read CI at the head from check-runs. Every red is answered in ## Red checks.
7. This PR edits CLAUDE.md, so it is policy. Say so explicitly, so the orchestrator can approve under the mandate at merge.

ev/HEAD.txt must hold the full 40-hex head sha, or the relay refuses the verdict.
Do not add Claude Code footers, Co-Authored-By/Claude-Session trailers or any claude.ai session link to commits, verdicts or comments.
